visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short hair wearing a blue hoodie and jeans stands in a supermarket aisle. Beside her is a giant orange bird mascot with a white face and yellow scarf. Her hands are raised in excitement as she smiles broadly. The background shows personal care products on shelves. (2) The woman holds up a large price tag sign printed with the number 89 and the text i價標. She points to the sign with her index finger, maintaining a joyous facial expression. The mascot waves its wings. Bright indoor lighting fills the retail space. (3) The scene shifts to a display of pastel-colored shampoo and body wash bottles. The woman points at specific products on the shelf while looking at the camera. The background environment is a clean, well-lit retail aisle with multiple product varieties visible. (4) The woman is in the toilet paper aisle next to a display of large tissue packs featuring bear illustrations. She leans against the product stack and smiles. The mascot stands nearby, its colorful wings spread. The lighting is uniform and bright across the supermarket. (5) The woman examines plastic-wrapped bread in the bakery section. She holds a loaf labeled Clean Label. The background features wooden shelves and a variety of baked goods under warm, bright lighting. (6) The woman and the bird mascot stand behind a metal shopping cart filled with various household products. A large blue lowercase i sign is attached to the front of the cart. They pose together in the middle of a spacious, well-lit supermarket aisle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Initiative -> Benefit Enumeration (Eco-friendly, Sustainable, Quality) -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for Carrefour Taiwan's 'i 價標' (i Price Tag) initiative. It uses a high-energy variety-show format featuring a female host and a mascot to explain the meaning of the initiative—focusing on environmental sustainability and product quality. It aims to encourage customers to purchase these specific items and participate in a social media giveaway.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand, display of brand logos, focus on specific store initiatives, and a call to action for a giveaway.
